parsed.reason: The text is in English although French was requested (wrong language). It omits the end time (4:00 PM), the venue name (Georgetown library) and the street address (9 Church St), and gives the start as '3:00' with no AM/PM. It recasts the event title "Jour de congé" as a statement about the day ('Tomorrow's a day off') and adds the invented inference that the family has 'a bit of breathing room', which is exactly the day-is-free claim forbidden when a timed event exists.
